greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lukaThixo nibe nalo lonke, nani nina nizele apha ukuzokufuna ubuso bakhe.
penitential:
Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
Krestu, usivele imfesane.
Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Kukho amaxesha apho ubomi busibonisa into encinci kakhulu, into ebonakala ingenamsebenzi, kodwa eyona nto iphethe ubunzulu obukhulu. Cinga ngesitshixo esilahlekileyo, okanye isiqwenga sephepha esibhaliweyo esilahleke phakathi kweencwadi ezininzi. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usinika imifanekiso emibini: umalusi olahlekelwe yimvu enye, nomfazi olahlekelwe yingqekembe enye. Akukho mntu uya kuqokelela izihlobo zakhe ngenxa yengqekembe enye kuphela, akunjalo? Kodwa uYesu uthi kunjalo. Uthi, 'Rejoice with me because I have found the coin that I lost.' UYesu usixelela ukuba kuThixo, akukho nto ilahlekayo engabalulekanga. Akukho mntu omncinci kangangokuba angakhangeleka.

Benjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto ngendlela eyodwa. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, umfana owayethanda ukwenza izinto ezinkulu, kodwa owayenentliziyo eyayibona ixabiso elikwinto nganye. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukujonga iinqwelo-moya, indlela awayehlekisa ngayo ngala mava e-'con chim airlines' awayeyila entloko yakhe. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoncumo, owayezimisele ukunika konke okwakhe. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, esemncinci, wathi kubazali bakhe ufuna ukunikela ngemali yakhe yonke yasebhange ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumntwana owayephila ngothando olungenamkhawulo.

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos uthi: 'But whatever gains I had, these I have come to consider a loss because of Christ.' UPawulos wayeyindoda eyayinezinto ezininzi zokuzigada, kodwa wazilahla zonke ngenxa yento enye: ukumazi uKrestu. UBen, ngendlela yakhe emfutshane kodwa eqaqambileyo, wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayefunda izibalo eziphezulu, owayeqonda i-AI, kodwa ekugqibeleni, wayeyazi ukuba eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukuba ngumntwana ohlonipha abazali bakhe, umntwana owayenoncumo olwalukhanyisa igumbi.

Kodwa masithethe inyaniso namhlanje. Ukulahlekelwa ngumntu othandekayo, njengoko uBen wasishiyayo ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, akulula. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa. Mhlawumbi uzibuza: 'Kutheni? Kwakutheni?'

Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

UYesu uthi kwiVangeli: 'Rejoice with me because I have found the coin that I lost.' UBen akalahlekanga. Ufumaneke kuThixo. Uphakathi kokukhanya. UBen, ngobukrelekrele bakhe, wayeyazi ukuba ubomi abupheleli apha. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayinezixhobo zokuqonda ikamva, eyayibona ukuba ubomi bunokubhabha kude. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokukhanya kukaKrestu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Krestu, ndikholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokusemthethweni kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya, uzalise intliziyo yam ngothando lwakho, kwaye ungenzi ukuba ndohlukane nawe nanini. Amen.
closing: Makube noxolo lweNkosi kunye nani nonke. Hambani ngoxolo, nithwele uthando lukaThixo ezintliziyweni zenu.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Thina singabatyhilelweyo, thina esikhonza ngoMoya kaThixo, abaqhayisa ngoKrestu Yesu, nabo bangabeki ithemba labo enyameni, nangona mna ndinazo izizathu zokuzithemba enyameni. Ukuba kukho omnye ocinga ukuba unokuzithemba enyameni, mna ndingaphezulu. Ndatyhilelwa ngomhla wesibhozo, ndingowesizwe sakwaSirayeli, wesizwe sakwaBhenjamin, ndingumHebhere ozelwe ngamaHebhere, ngokuphathelele umthetho ndingumFarisi, ngokukhuthele ndanditshutshisa iBandla, nangobulungisa obusekelwe emthethweni ndandingenasiphoso. Kodwa nantoni na endandiyithatha njengenzuzo, ezi ndizithatha njengelahleko ngenxa kaKrestu. Ngaphezulu koko, ndithatha yonke into njengelahleko ngenxa yenzuzo enkulu yokumazi uKrestu Yesu iNkosi yam.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Mavuya iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi. Mvumeleni, mumdumise, nibhengeze zonke izenzo zakhe ezimangalisayo. Qhayisani ngegama lakhe elingcwele; mavuya iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi! R. Mavuya iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi. Jonganani neNkosi emandleni ayo; funani ukumkhonza rhoqo. Khumbulani izenzo zakhe ezimangalisayo azenzileyo, imiqondiso yakhe, nezigwebo azithethileyo. R. Mavuya iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi. Nina nzala ka-Abraham, izicaka zakhe, nina bonyana bakaYakobi, abanyuliweyo bakhe! Yena, iNkosi, unguThixo wethu; izigwebo zakhe zixhaphakile ehlabathini lonke. R. Mavuya iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Abathelisi nezoni babesondela bonke ukuze baphulaphule uYesu, kodwa abaFarisi nabaBhali baqala ukukhalaza, besithi, 'Lo mntu wamkela izoni kwaye utya nazo.' Ngoko uYesu wabathethela lo mzekeliso. 'Ngubani na kuni onempahla elikhulu, elahlekelwe yimvu enye, ongayi kushiya amashumi alithoba anesithoba entlango aze aye emva kwaleyo ilahlekileyo ade ayifumane? Xa ayifumeneyo, uyibeka emagxeni akhe ngovuyo olukhulu, kwaye xa efika ekhaya, ubiza abahlobo bakhe nabamelwane bakhe athi kubo, 'Vuyani nam kuba ndiyifumene imvu yam elahlekileyo.' Ndithi kuni, ngokunjalo kuya kubakho uvuyo olukhulu ezulwini ngomoni omnye oguqukayo kunangamashumi alithoba anesithoba abantu abalungileyo abangadingi nguquko. Okanye ngowuphi umfazi onengqekembe ezilishumi, elahlekelwe yingqekembe enye, ongayi kukhanyisa isibane aze ahlambulule indlu, akhangele ngononophelo ade ayifumane? Xa ayifumeneyo, ubiza abahlobo bakhe nabamelwane bakhe athi kubo, 'Vuyani nam kuba ndiyifumene ingqekembe endiyilahlekelweyo.' Ngokunjalo, ndithi kuni, kuya kubakho uvuyo phakathi kweengelosi zikaThixo ngomoni omnye oguqukayo.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
